title: 第9章：仓库，140斤野菜
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“试试？”

    “万一呢？”

    马超开始尝试，他已经成功过一次，肉包子，猪五花和猪板油都是从另一个时空带回来的，可马超心里还是有些慌，毕竟关系到马建业的手术费，说一点不紧张是骗人的。

    好在一切都很顺利。

    马超和一筐野菜同时出现在时空屋。

    左边是蓝色门，通往40年后，也就是2025年。

    右边则是红色门，返回80年代。

    时空屋里安安静静，只有两扇门散发的幽光，映得竹筐里的野菜愈发鲜嫩。

    即便不止一次看过这样的画面，马超内心仍然感到震撼，更不清楚这里是如何打造的。

    马超深吸一口气，将一筐野菜全部倾泻在空地上，然后静静等待，也不知道过了多久，地上的野菜既没有消失，也没有出现任何变质的迹象。

    他甚至有一种错觉，时空屋的时间是静止的。

    只要存放在时空屋的物品，就不会损坏变质。

    “成了！”

    马超忍不住低喝一声，眼里骤然亮起光芒，之前的忐忑不安尽数消失，只留下眼底的兴奋与惊喜。

    惊喜之余，马超又开始尝试把野菜收进时空屋，而人不用跟着进去，不然每次人和东西一起消失，难免有疏忽的时候。

    随后，马超将手搭在一捆刚挖的野菜上面。

    下一秒。

    神奇的一幕发生了。

    马超人还留在原地，手里的那捆野菜却凭空消失。

    与此同时，马超立刻感应到时空屋多了一捆野菜，就连野菜根须上的泥土都在。

    “竟然真的可以！”

    马超感到悬着的心终于落下，他这下彻底没了后顾之忧。

    而且时空屋有一百平的面积，可以存放很多物资，最关键的是，少了突然消失所暴露的风险。

    一次。

    两次。

    马超多次尝试后，收取物资变得越发娴熟。

    同时也让他摸清了时空屋的一定规律，那就是，只有马超身体触碰到的东西，才可以被收进时空屋，而且物品的大小不能超过时空屋的面积。

    换句话说，时空屋只有一百平米，就决定了存放物品的大小和数量上限。
content_en:
"Try?"

    "What if?"

    Ma Chao started to try. He had already succeeded once. The meat buns, pork belly and pork suet were all brought back from another time and space, but Ma Chao was still a little panicked. After all, it was related to Ma Jianye's surgery fee. It would be a lie to say that he was not nervous at all.

    Fortunately everything went smoothly.

    Ma Chao and a basket of wild vegetables appeared in the time and space room at the same time.

    On the left is the blue door, which leads to 40 years later, that is, 2025.

    On the right is the red door, returning to the 1980s.

    The space-time house was quiet, with only the faint light from the two doors making the wild vegetables in the bamboo baskets look even more tender.

    Even though he had seen such a scene more than once, Ma Chao was still shocked in his heart, and he had no idea how this place was built.

    Ma Chao took a deep breath, dumped a basket of wild vegetables on the open ground, and then waited quietly. He didn't know how long it took, but the wild vegetables on the ground neither disappeared nor showed any signs of deterioration.

    He even had the illusion that time in the Space-Time House stood still.

    As long as items are stored in the Time and Space House, they will not be damaged or deteriorate.

    "It's done!"

    Ma Chao couldn't help but let out a low drink, his eyes suddenly lit up, and all the previous uneasiness disappeared, leaving only the excitement and surprise in his eyes.

    Surprised, Ma Chao began to try to collect wild vegetables into the time and space room again, and people did not need to follow him in, otherwise, every time people and things disappeared together, there would inevitably be oversights.

    Then, Ma Chao put his hand on a bundle of freshly dug wild vegetables.

    The next second.

    A magical scene happened.

    Ma Chaoren remained where he was, but the bundle of wild vegetables in his hand disappeared out of thin air.

    At the same time, Ma Chao immediately sensed that there was a bundle of wild vegetables in the space-time house, and even the soil on the roots of the wild vegetables was there.

    "It actually works!"

    Ma Chao felt that his hanging heart had finally dropped, and now he had no worries at all.

    Moreover, the space-time house has an area of ​​100 square meters, which can store a lot of materials. The most important thing is that there is less risk of sudden disappearance.

    once.

    twice.

    After Ma Chao tried many times, he became more and more skilled in collecting supplies.

    At the same time, it also allowed him to understand certain rules of the time and space room, that is, only things that Ma Chao's body touches can be taken into the time and space room, and the size of the items cannot exceed the area of ​​the time and space room.

    In other words, the space-time room is only one hundred square meters, which determines the upper limit of the size and quantity of stored items.
title_en: Chapter 9: Warehouse, 140 pounds of wild vegetables
